sections.text: RIH w/ perforating BHA to 149,3 m shot 146 m)
Performed pre-job meeting to fire guns and circulate gas
Closed UPR, lined up to pump through choke and MGS, circulated w/ 300l/min 0 bar

Broke TDS, dropped 1 3/8in ball M/u TDS. Took up/down weights 72t/69t. Closed UPR. Pumped down ball w/ 160 l/min, pressured up to 135 bar to shear ball seat. Good indication of guns firing. Top shot 146 m, bottom shot 149m
Continued circulating w/ 160 l/min until stable returnes observed. Increased pump rate to 1000 l/min 3,5bar. MAX gas 3,6 h2s 1 ppm fluid). Circulated 3,5x bottoms up
Flowchecked well through the choke. OK. Opened UPR and flowchecked well. OK
POOH w/ perforating BHA from 149m
L/d perforating BHA
Changed handling equipment and prepared to p/u EZSV plug
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u EZSV
P/u EZSV plug and RT
RIH w/ EZSV 29) to 854 mmd. Average running speed 556 m/hr.
Established circulation and washed the setting area, 500 LPM/ 0,3 bar. Installed the 14" EZSV mechanical plug at 854 mmd. Load tested the plug with 10 ton.
POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 854 m to 645 mmd Avg. Tripping speed 418 m/hr.
Changed inserts in BX elevator to 5" and p/u RTTS plug. Removed PS-21 slips and installed master bushing. Changed inserts in BX elevator back to 5 1/2"
RIH w/ RTTS and safety joint on 5 1/2" DP from 645 m to 788 m plug depth at 143. 6m). RTTS plug hung up at 143. 6m. Pulled up and re-attempted to RIH. Unable to run RTTS plug past restriction in WH.
Evaluated situation. Meanwhile greased and checked dies on IRN.
POOH w/ RTTS on 5 1/2" DP from 788 m to 645 m.
Changed BX inserts to 5". L/d the RTTS and safety joint.
P/u and m/u 3m pup for space out. Pulled master bushing and installed PS-21 slips.
RIH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 648 m to 854 m Avg. Tripping speed 275 m/hr. Tagged EZSV w/ 2 ton to confirm depth.
P/u and m/u pump-in sub. Stung into EZSV and set down 10 ton. Connected cement hose and installed lo-torque valve to pump-in sub.
Closed UPR lined up and pumped 10m3 push pill at 1000lpm 12 bar. Circulated SW at 1000-1800 LPM 12 bar until clean returns. Meanwhile performed TBT for cement job.
Opened UPR and flow checked well, static.

Lined up and pumped 20m3 wash pill at 1285 LPM 11. 5 bar. Closed upper FOSV and trapped 20 bar behind. Applied 20 bar from cement unit to drill floor and confirmed line-up. Pumped 33 m3 1. 90sg cement slurry at 600 LPM. Added well-life to the first 10m3 of cement slurry kg/m3). Chased cement by pumping SW at 1000 LPM 12 bar. After catching up with cement, continued displacing cement with SW at 1000 LPM 12 bar, then reduced rate to 800 LPM the last 1. 7m3. Pumped totally 11. 7m3 SW. Pressure increased from 12 bar to 47 bar, indicating that cement entered annulus. Recorded 1. 8m3 losses during displacement. Estimated TOC in annulus at 480 mmd.
Released from EZSV plug and rigged down cement hose. L/d pump-in sub.
POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 854 m to 811 m. Installed pup joint w/ pre-loaded sponge ball. Circulated with 3450 LPM 31 bar until clean returns. Measured 10 gas, reduced rate to 1980 LPM.
POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 811 m to 647 m. Avg. Tripping speed 219 m/hr.
L/d 3m pup joint.
POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 644 m to surface. Avg. Tripping speed 970 m/hr.
Removed PS-21 slips and installed master bushing. L/d EZSV RT.
Cleaned and cleared drill floor.
WOC meanwhile maintenance replaced alignment cylinders on TDS performed PM inspection on drawworks performed PM check on FWD PRS
